title: Price version
description: What one provider charged from one date: unit rates, how each is metered, the pages they were read from, what the list leaves out and what is still unknown. Rates are decimal strings, never JSON numbers. A rate that is absent was not published, which is not the same as free: a published free rate is `"0"`. Stored status, effective_to, first_seen_at, last_confirmed_at and content_hash belong to the database, not to this document.

version.description: The id every cost names: the provider, an @, and the UTC date the version was read, for example e2b@2026-10-20-061802Z. If a provider gets more than one version on one day, append the UTC time as HHMMSSZ, for example modal@2026-10-20-061900Z. The provider part equals `provider`.

effective_from.description: When this price starts applying: the provider's announced date if it gave one, else when it was first seen.

retrieved_at.description: When the pages below were read.

boundary.description: Legacy: where billing starts and ends, kept so documents published before 0.2 stay byte-identical. Code ignores it; the provider's billing.yaml is the source.

supersedes.description: Earlier price version ids corrected by this document. Selectors ignore these versions when the bundled price files include this document.

month_hours.description: The price version's hours per calendar month for monthly rates, such as 730 for 365/12 days.

snapshot_storage.description: Independent retained snapshot storage price; absent means unpriced. A disk rate proxy must say so explicitly.

image_storage.description: Independent price of storing a deployment image the provider keeps for fast, repeatable creation; absent means unpriced. Not a sandbox's own cost: no usage record carries image size.

volume_storage.description: Independent price of a provider volume, billed on its provisioned size for as long as it exists; absent means unpriced. Not a sandbox's own cost: no usage record carries volume size.

included_gb.description: Volume storage the provider includes before the rate applies, in included_unit (Modal: 1 TiB a month, written 1024 GiB).

sources.description: The pages the rates and rules were read from, each with a verbatim quote.

classes.description: One rate set per class or runtime the provider prices differently (Modal's gVisor and VM, a Daytona class). Exactly one is the default, which applies when a usage record names no class. Class names are unique.

exclusions.description: Charges outside a sandbox's own cost that the rates do not cover: plan fees, concurrency add-ons, credits, storage that is not priced from a sandbox's size.

coverage.description: Every billable charge of a managed sandbox, one entry per kind, each stated as `in_quote`, `not_billed` or `unbounded`. `reservation_quote` returns `bounded` only when every kind is stated and none of cpu, memory or disk is `unbounded`; a missing kind makes the quote `unknown`, and so does a version without this block. Kinds: cpu, memory, disk, creation, egress, snapshot_storage, image_storage, volume_storage, requests (per-request or per-use charges such as starts, proxies and drive reads).

open_questions.description: What the pages leave unclear, so a reader knows which rule is an assumption.

treatment.description: `in_quote`: priced into a reservation quote (time-bounded, or the creation fee). `not_billed`: the provider does not bill it on managed sandboxes. `unbounded`: billable or possibly billable, but no ceiling follows from a size and a duration (egress, retained storage, request- or use-based); it is outside the quote and settled from the provider's own cost.

source.description: Where the treatment was read: a URL listed in `sources`, or a repo-relative path to committed evidence under `providers/`.

note.description: The reason, in one sentence. For a charge the provider does not publish, say so: unpublished is never free.

default.description: Present, and true, on the default class only.

covers.description: The spec classes this rate set prices (Modal's default covers default and vm; Daytona's on-demand covers container and vm). A usage record's class names a spec class. Absent, the class covers only the spec class of its own name. No spec class is covered by two classes of one version.

region_multipliers.description: A multiplier on every rate of this class for sandboxes in the named region (Modal's 1.15 for a broad region). A region that is not listed is charged at the base rate.

rates.description: Unit rates, each optional. A rate is a price and the unit it is a price per, as the provider publishes it.

gpu.description: Rates by GPU model, keyed by gpu-registry identifiers.

size_per_unit.description: vCPUs one core covers. Required for a core unit, which is not a vCPU (Modal's physical core), and absent for a vCPU unit.
GiB one GB covers: 1 where the provider's GB is read as a GiB, as Vercel's and Blaxel's examples do. Required for a GB unit and absent for a GiB unit.

machine_rates.description: Flat per-size machine rates, keyed by the provider's own size name. Each entry prices one published bundle: a sandbox whose size matches the entry's cpu and memory_gib is billed the flat rate while the meter runs it. A sandbox size that matches no entry has no machine price. Used where the provider sells a bundle with no published per-unit split.

memory_gib.description: GiB of memory the published size gives; where the provider quotes GB it is read as a GiB.

per.description: gib is 2^30 bytes; gb is 10^9 bytes.

meter.description: How each time-billed resource is metered. A resource with a rate and no meter rule cannot be priced.

basis.description: allocated: the size the sandbox has. active: only while the resource is in use (Vercel's CPU). larger_of_request_and_use: whichever is greater (Modal).

billed_states.description: The sandbox states in which this resource is charged.

minimum_seconds.description: The least that is charged for each period in a billed state.

increment_seconds.description: Each period in a billed state is rounded up to a multiple of this.

free_quantity.description: An allowance that is free for every sandbox, in the resource's size unit (vCPUs, GiB, GPUs). An allowance shared across an account is an exclusion, not a meter rule.

basis.description: allocated: the size the sandbox has; active: only while the resource is in use; larger_of_request_and_use: whichever is greater.

memory_steps_mib.description: Discrete billed memory sizes in MiB. A request rounds up to the next listed size; a request above every tier has no price.

disk_gib_per_memory_gib.description: Set where the provider charges disk by raising the memory it bills: how many GiB of disk count as one GiB of memory (Modal's 20). The class then has no disk rate.

timestamp.description: A UTC time, ending in Z.

decimal.description: A non-negative decimal number as a string, in plain notation without an exponent.

positive_decimal.description: A decimal string greater than zero.
